findings.finding: Ottobock, the main prosthetics peer and the only one that spoke after Embla's 21 Jul print, reported on 13 Aug a strong Q2: Products & Components (B2B) +12.1% to EUR 248.0m, H1 B2B organic +8.7% 'driven mainly by prosthetics and neuro-orthotics', and it raised its FY organic guide to 6-8%. This supports continued double-digit organic growth in Embla's P&NO segment (58% of Q2 sales), but Ottobock's Americas were -1.1%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: P&NO strength drove the beats behind Q3 2025 (+4.44% on 2025-10-21) and Q2 2026 (+3.42% on 2026-07-21)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it has been public for two months and EMBLA rose from 26.35 to about 29 DKK in August before giving it back. It is a peer proxy, not company data, and the bar (USD 254.5m, about 6% organic) already assumes P&NO strength. It is filed small because, if P&NO had decelerated, nothing in the peer data would have warned of it.
findings.independence: Embla's own Q2 P&NO +12% organic and management's 'strong performance in our Prosthetics business across regions in the second half' (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bfb329cc8f0bd6d03de2d6c89a7955417&lang=en&src=listed), the same direction from a different source

findings.finding: The Q3 comparison is the toughest of the year: Q3 2025 organic growth was 7% with P&NO +13%, against 5% in Q2 2025. On Q2 2026's two-year stacked organic growth of 11% (6%+5%), Q3 would print about 4%. Guidance arithmetic says the same: H1 organic is 5%, so the 6% midpoint needs about 7% in H2 against roughly 7% H2 2025 comps. That makes a narrowing toward the low end of 5-7% more likely than toward the top.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 printed 4% organic, below consensus, and the stock fell 3.44% (2026-04-28). At Q2 2026 the guide was narrowed (top cut from 8% to 7%) with a beat, and the stock rose 3.42%. Guide narrowing has not by itself been punished.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: comps are public and sell-side models carry them. But the consensus revenue (USD 254.5m) implies roughly 6% organic once about 2pt of Streifeneder M&A and an FX headwind of under 1pt are netted out. A two-year stack accelerating from 11% to about 13% is assumed rather than evidenced. If the market priced a low-end print, the EPS trend would be falling, and it rose from 0.427 to 0.438 DKK over the last 7 days.
findings.independence: Management said on the Q2 call that H2 would be stronger in all three segments (https://media.ossur.com/image/upload/v1784625098/embla-investor-relations/financial-reports/2026/interim-report-q2-2026/transcript-q2-2026.pdf). That cuts AGAINST this finding and is why it is small. Supporting: Patient Care was still -2% in Q2 (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bfb329cc8f0bd6d03de2d6c89a7955417&lang=en&src=listed).

findings.finding: Q2's 22% EBITDA margin and its 28% EPS beat included a USD 4m gross / USD 3m net US tariff refund (about 1.2pt of margin). The CFO said only about USD 1m more is expected in all of H2, timing unknown. Q3 2026 therefore faces Q3 2025's 22% margin without that support. A seasonal model (Q3 about 1.3pt above Q2 ex-refund) lands near 22.5%, roughly where the DKK 0.438 EPS consensus sits.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026, the refund quarter, rose 3.42% on the day and a further 5.04% three sessions later. There is no prior quarter where a refund dropped out.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the CFO said it on the call. It is filed because a sequential EBITDA-dollar comparison against Q2 will look flat to down on headline, and on European names a one-off-inflated prior quarter has been sold (H&M). It is a one-off below the guide, so it is a fraction of operating money.
findings.independence: Inderes (22 Jul) called the refund an 'engangseffekt fra tarifrefusioner' (one-off effect from tariff refunds): https://www.inderes.dk/analyst-comments/dagens-aktienyheder-22072026-embla-medical

findings.finding: EUR/USD averaged 1.1506 in Q3 2026 and stands at 1.122 on 2026-10-19. The company's July FY assumption was 1.155, and it discloses that a +/-5% EUR/USD move changes annual EBITDA by +/-USD 3.5-4.5m unhedged. The euro's fall since then trims Q4 reported sales and slightly pressures the FY margin, which affects the tone of the reiterated guide but not organic growth.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to FX commentary on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission using the company's own disclosed sensitivity. A roughly 3% euro move over about 2.5 months is worth under USD 1m of EBITDA, so it is near zero by construction. FX rates are fully public.

findings.finding: Enovis (DJO bracing) reported on 6 Aug that global bracing grew 4% in Q2 2026, with mid-single-digit US growth. That market growth fits management's promise of a stronger H2 in Embla's Bracing & Supports, which grew only 1% organic in Q2, against an easy Q3 2025 comp of flat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Bracing has been flat to +1% for five quarters with no measured standalone reaction. It is 15% of sales.
findings.why_not_priced: A peer proxy, public since August, for a segment that is 15% of sales. Embla's management names 'continued competitive pressure in selected markets', so market growth need not reach Embla. Small by construction.
findings.independence: Embla's Q2 call: 'progress on our Bracing business here towards the latter half of quarter two and expect that to continue into the second half' (https://media.ossur.com/image/upload/v1784625098/embla-investor-relations/financial-reports/2026/interim-report-q2-2026/transcript-q2-2026.pdf)
